## Overview

This page describes the entity-relationship (ER) model for **artworks**. The model for artworks shown in an exhibition builds on it and is described in [Item in Exhibition Data Model](item-in-exhibition-datamodel.qmd).

The single source of truth is [wikibase-model.json](wikibase-model.json). The tables below are generated from it, and the same file drives the creation of Wikibase properties and class items (see `catalogues/wikibase-artwork-load.ipynb`).

::: {.callout-note}
The field list is **provisional** (version 0.1). Properties are mapped to four schemas: Wikidata, CIDOC CRM 7.1.3, Linked Art and LIDO. Iconclass and AAT are used as controlled vocabularies for subjects and terms.
:::

```{mermaid}
erDiagram

    MATERIAL {
        string term_id PK

    }
    OBJECT_TYPE {
        string term_id PK
        string label_en
        string label_de
        string aat_id

    }

        string term_id PK
        string label_en
        string label_de
        string wikidata_qid
    }
```

The authoritative artwork source is the attached CSV artifact and its field names are the ones used below. Multi-valued fields, where present, follow the same `;`-separated pattern used in the source data.

`Exhibited at` is represented on the exhibition-item relationship rather than as a direct attribute of the artwork entity, even though the import CSV still contains the column for catalogue loading.

## Classes

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

model = json.loads(Path("wikibase-model.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
ns = model["namespaces"]

def cell(v):
    return "" if v in (None, "") else str(v).replace("|", "\\|")

ARTWORK_CLASSES = {"artwork", "person", "material", "object_type", "place"}

print("| Class | Label (EN / DE) | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for c in model["classes"]:
    if c["key"] not in ARTWORK_CLASSES:
        continue
    e = c["equivalents"]
    wd = e.get("wikidata")
    wd_cell = f"[{wd}]({ns['wikidata']}{wd})" if wd else ""
    print(f"| **{c['key']}** | {c['label_en']} / {c['label_de']} | {wd_cell} | {cell(e.get('cidoc'))} | {cell(e.get('linked_art'))} | {cell(e.get('lido'))} |")
```

## Properties

```{python}
#| output: asis
ARTWORK_USES = {"artwork", "person", "material", "object_type", "place", "property", "class"}

print("| Property | Label (EN / DE) | Wikibase datatype | Used on | Wikidata | CIDOC CRM | Linked Art | LIDO |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for p in model["properties"]:
    if not (set(p["used_on"]) & ARTWORK_USES):
        continue
    e = p["equivalents"]
    print("| " + " | ".join([
        f"**{p['key']}**",
        f"{p['label_en']} / {p['label_de']}",
        p["datatype"],
        ", ".join(u for u in p["used_on"] if u in ARTWORK_USES),
        cell(e.get("wikidata")),
        cell(e.get("cidoc")),
        cell(e.get("linked_art")),
        cell(e.get("lido")),
    ]) + " |")
```

## Controlled vocabularies

| Vocabulary | Used for | Stored as |
|---|---|---|
| Iconclass | Subject of an artwork (`iconclass_notations`) | External identifier, notation such as `71H7` |
| AAT (Getty) | Materials and object types (`aat_id`) | External identifier, numeric ID |
| GND | Persons (`gnd_id`) | External identifier |
| Wikidata | Cross-reference for all entity types (`wikidata_qid`) | External identifier |

## Dimensions

Height, width and depth are stored as Wikibase `quantity` values in centimetres. The unit is a local item "centimetre" created by the load notebook, which links to Wikidata unit Q174728 through the equivalent-property mechanism.

## CSV source fields

The source schema for artworks is the field list already used in the attached `artwork.csv`:

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Instance of (main)` | Yes | main class, usually `work of art` |
| `Object type (type of artwork)` | Yes | the narrower object type |
| `Title` | Yes | artwork title |
| `Creator` | Yes | creator item |
| `Inception` | Yes | creation date |
| `Main Subject` | No | subject or motif |
| `Materials` | Yes | material terms |
| `Inventory Number` | No | museum/collection id |
| `Catalog Code` | No | catalogue code |
| `Width` | Yes | dimension |
| `Height` | Yes | dimension |
| `Depth` | No | dimension |
| `Part of Series` | No | series membership |
| `Depicts` | No | depicted subject |
| `Image` | No | image URL |
| `Exhibited at` | Yes | exhibition item |
| `Current Owner` | No | current owner or keeper |
| `Commons category` | No | Commons category link |

Rules:

- These column names are now the authoritative field list for the artwork data model.
- The internal `*_id` and `term.csv` layer remains available as a loading convenience, but the source CSV is the governing schema.
- Dates may be `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`; a range such as `1997-98` is loaded with its start year and a warning.
- `Title` is loaded as monolingual text with language code `mul`.
